The '''F1 exploration droid''' was designed to be used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] on the frontier, acting as a companion and protector.

==Description==
The F1 exploration droid was a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall quadrupedal droid with a distinctly [[Canine/Legends|canine]] look.<ref name="GG8" /> The F1 was equipped with two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]], [[Olfactory sensor/Legends|olfactory sensors]], a [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] array<ref name="CFTD" /> and [[Infrared receptor|infrared sensors]], as well as a communications array that linked to [[Starship/Legends|starship]] located at the rear of its body. It also had a set of [[Grasper jaw|grasping jaws]] that were specifically designed to hold something without crushing it. However, the droid had limited verbal communication capability, and could only emit a narrow range of warning sounds.<ref name="GG8" />

==Role==
The F1 exploration droid was designed to accompany [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] into the field during their explorations of new [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="GG8" /> as a companion and protector.<ref name="CFTD" /> Using their substantial sensor array, F1s were intended to alert the scout to any approaching lifeforms or vehicles that could cause potential harm to their owner. The droid could use their sensors to locate and potentially rescue a scout that was in danger, and use its grasping jaws to lift and drag them out of danger.<ref name="GG8" />

==History==
[[File:F1ExplorationDroid-CynabarsFantasticTechnology.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A F1 exploration droid]]
F1 droids were favored by scouts exploring the frontier.<ref name="GG8" /> The scout [[Zeb (scout)|Zeb]] used a pack of F1s during one of their earliest scouting missions. Zeb found that by tasking the droids with perimeter security, the scout could relax and use the time to analyze recon data without the fear of being ambushed by a local beast.<ref name="CFTD" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Davaire Colmar]], posting in version 4.7.1 of [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]] recounted a rumor that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Noval Garaint]], based in the [[Kheedar system/Legends|Kheedar system]], had reprogrammed a half dozen F1s to serve as heavily-armed bodyguards. The [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]] supposedly had a run in with them during a break-in.<ref name="CFTD" />
